problemSigns.sign: Opener hums but the door doesn't move
problemSigns.detail: The motor runs, but the door remains stationary. This often points to a stripped drive gear or a broken belt/chain.

problemSigns.sign: Door reverses before touching the floor
problemSigns.detail: The door begins to close, then reverses direction before reaching the closed position. This is usually a sign of misaligned safety sensors or an obstruction.
Your remote control or exterior keypad no longer activates the opener. This could be a battery issue, a programming fault, or a logic board problem.
The indicator lights on your safety sensors are blinking. This signals an obstruction in the sensor path or a sensor malfunction.

problemSigns.sign: Trolley moves but door stays down
problemSigns.detail: The trolley glides along the rail, but the door itself does not move. This indicates a disconnected or broken trolley carriage.
